Special Branch
February 27, 1942

Miss Kira P. Mugantseff - Antecedents and character.

Kira Petrovna MUGANTSEFF, Russian, was born on June 19, 1926 at Mukden and is the eldest of the three daughters of the late Mr. P. Mugantseff, former officer of the Russian army. The family arrived in Shanghai from Tsinanfu some time in 1928. The father was employed as a watchman with Amos Bird Company, 1 Tengyueh Road, until 1934 when he died of tuberculosis.

Miss Mugantseff is reported to have attended the First Russian School, Baikal Road, for a period and from 1936 to December, 1940 - the Public & Thos. Hanbury School for Girls. Leaving the latter school from Form IV at the age of 15 years she is believed to have studied stenography for a few months, after which she was engaged by the General Accident Insurance Company, 18 The Bund, as an assistant stenographer. She worked in this capacity from August, 1941 to the end of January, 1942 when her services were dispensed with on account of general business depression.

Enquiries show that while in school her conduct was very good, but that during the past year there has been a certain change in her general demeanour which is regarded with disapproval by those who knew her before. However, nothing has been learned that could reflect unfavourably on her character.

1942年2月27日

基拉·P·穆甘采夫小姐 - 背景及品行。

基拉·彼得罗芙娜·穆甘采夫（Kira Petrovna MUGANTSEFF），俄国人，1926年6月19日出生于奉天，是已故俄国军队前军官 P·穆甘采夫先生三个女儿中的长女。该家庭于1928年某时从济南府抵达上海。其父受雇于腾越路1号阿莫斯·伯德公司（Amos Bird Company）担任看守，直至1934年因肺结核去世。

据报，穆甘采夫小姐曾就读于贝加尔路第一俄侨学校一段时间，并于1936年至1940年12月期间就读于公立暨汤姆斯·汉伯里女子学校（Public & Thos. Hanbury School for Girls）。她15岁时从该校四年级离校，据悉随后学习了数月速记，之后被外滩18号通用意外保险公司（General Accident Insurance Company）聘为助理速记员。她在此职位上工作至1942年1月底，后因商业普遍萧条而被解雇。

调查显示，她在学期间品行优良，但在过去一年中，她的总体举止发生了一定变化，令以前认识她的人感到不满。然而，并未发现任何有损其品行的情况。

目前，她与母亲 E.S·穆甘采夫太太（44岁）以及最后两个妹妹（分别为10岁和9岁）同住于中山路14号，她们
（印：J.B·福斯特注 日期 1942年3月3日）

attending the Public & Thos. Hanbury School for Girls.
It is reported that Mrs. Mugantseff's material circum-
stances have never been very good since the death of
her husband. At present she is employed as a cashier at
a Russian bakery located at 37 Wayside Road.

Mr. D.T. Selenineff, who agreed to undertake
the responsibility for any debts that F.S. Margison may
incur, has for the past 16 years been employed with the
Shanghai Power Company as a fireman. He served in the
same regiment with the late Mr. Mugantseff and knows the
family well. Being a hardworking, sober and thrifty man
he is reported to have certain savings. He is the lessee
of houses No. 6 and 14 Chusan Road. Interviewed on
26-2-42 he confirmed that he had signed the guarantee
form, a copy of which is attached to F.S. Margison's
report dated 17-2-42.

D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch

正就读于公立暨汤姆斯·汉伯里女子学校。
据报，自丈夫去世后，穆甘采夫太太的经济状况一直不太宽裕。目前，她在位于韦赛德路37号的一家俄式面包房担任出纳。

D.T·谢列尼涅夫先生同意承担 F.S·马吉森可能产生的任何债务责任，他在过去16年间受雇于上海电力公司担任司炉工。他曾与已故的穆甘采夫先生在同一团服役，对该家庭十分了解。据报道，他是一位勤劳、清醒且节俭的人，并有一定的积蓄。他是中山路6号和14号房屋的承租人。在1942年2月26日接受问询时，他确认已签署担保书，副本附于 F.S·马吉森1942年2月17日的报告后。

D. I.

特务科主管警官
